meta.objective: Run a deep-search-style certainty-scored research pass, using a deep-workflow artifact, to determine whether shortlisted V4 candidate-paper resources are reconstructable enough for fair judge-gym audits and which targets are best supported by current public materials.

decisions.decision: Treat the question as a research-only certainty exercise over target viability, not as an implementation pass.
Use public-resource sufficiency and fairness-of-reconstruction as the core scoring dimensions.
